plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Cybersecurity and Information Assurance A.S. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7989/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. Map states Total Units 62; verified = 16+15+15+16 = 62 (all semester headers match their rows). CISN 304 co-requisite per map: CISC 323 & CISC 356. These courses are NOT sequenced anywhere in the map; they are carried under external_prereqs and encoded on CISN 304, with the co-requisite (same semester or earlier) documented here. CERTIFICATION ALTERNATIVES per map footnotes: CISN 300 or Microsoft AZ-800 certification; CISN 304 or CompTIA Network+ certification; CISS 310 or CompTIA Security+ certification. Semester 1 elective suggestion: MATH 400 Calculus I (5 units; pre-req MATH 375 or MATH 372 and MATH 373). Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): CISC 310 advisory familiar with basic functions of word process, spreadsheet, web browser software applications; CISC 360 advisory CISC 302 & 310; CISN 300 advisory CISC 310; CISN 304 advisory CISC 302, 308, or 310; CISS 310 advisory CISN 300 & 304; CISS 315 advisory CISS 300; CISS 321 advisory CISN 304 or 341; CISW 375 advisory CISW 410. Local Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor. Program also provides preparation for nationally recognized certifications in Cybersecurity.
